generationInputs.prompt: A digitally drawn illustration in a clean, graphic, and expressive modern emoji style shows two happy yellow emojis with bold black outlines and flat, vibrant color fills. One emoji is lying on its back and wearing rectangular black-framed glasses, and the other is lying on its stomach as if looking in a mirror reflection. Both emojis have a round head with two large, expressive brown eyes with white highlights and black pupils. The emoji lying on its back has eyes looking upward from behind the glasses, and the emoji lying on its stomach has the back of its head visible. The emoji on its back has thick, curved black eyebrows raised in a happy expression and a wide, curved black line indicating a smile. The emoji lying on its back has two muscular arms extended outwards with closed, clenched fists, and the emoji lying on its stomach has two muscular arms extended outwards with open hands in a cheerful gesture. Below the torso are two muscular legs extended outwards with feet pointing outwards. Very thin black thong bottoms with bold black outlines are worn low on each emoji's body. The emoji lying on its stomach has a visible thinner waist and back. There is subtle shading suggesting a surface below the emojis.
